painpoints.title: Price Opacity
painpoints.desc: Patients cannot get a cost estimate before care. 'How much will this cost?' is unanswerable until the EOB arrives weeks later.
painpoints.consumer: 292M Americans with private or public health insurance attempting to book non-emergency care
painpoints.market: Healthcare is 18% of US GDP ($4.5T). 70% of consumers don't price-shop — not by choice, because they can't.

painpoints.title: Fragmented Provider Search
painpoints.desc: Patients jump across 5+ surfaces to find a provider: insurer directory, Google, Zocdoc, MyChart, review sites. No single starting point.
painpoints.consumer: Patients trying to find in-network specialists, PCPs, urgent care, or imaging centers
painpoints.market: 1B+ annual US outpatient visits. Each search takes 45-90 min across fragmented tools.

painpoints.title: Ghost Networks
painpoints.desc: 55%+ of provider directories contain critical errors. Patients book 'in-network,' receive out-of-network bills. 53% of mental health directories are inaccurate.
painpoints.consumer: Anyone who verified coverage before booking only to be surprised by the bill
painpoints.market: Patients using inaccurate directories are 4x more likely to receive surprise bills.

painpoints.title: Insurance Confusion
painpoints.desc: Patients can't decode their own SBC/plan. Deductible vs. coinsurance vs. copay vs. OOP max — most patients can't define all four correctly.
painpoints.consumer: 180M Americans with employer-sponsored insurance — most cannot accurately state their own deductible
painpoints.market: 42% of patients find cost estimates confusing or hard to understand. SBC has no machine-readable standard.

painpoints.title: No Provenance on Estimates
painpoints.desc: Existing tools show numbers with no source, confidence, or explanation. No tool tags whether a number is a fact, inference, or assumption.
painpoints.who: Any patient using a cost estimator
painpoints.consumer: Growing segment of consumers who want to price-shop but cannot evaluate trustworthiness of estimates
painpoints.market: No existing consumer healthcare tool implements provenance-first estimation. Clearest differentiation gap.

painpoints.title: Post-Visit Surprise Bills
painpoints.desc: True cost revealed only after EOB arrives. Consumer commits — books, travels, receives care — before knowing what they'll owe.
painpoints.who: All insured patients receiving non-cash care
painpoints.consumer: Anyone who has received a bill materially different from what they expected
painpoints.market: Surprise billing is #1 healthcare financial complaint. No Surprises Act (2022) covers some cases but leaves most outpatient ambiguity unresolved.

hmw.title: HMW give patients a trustworthy cost estimate before they commit to care?
HMW become the single starting point for provider search — like Google for healthcare?
HMW surface network status with honest provenance and uncertainty?
HMW help patients understand their own insurance plan in under 2 minutes?
HMW tag every cost number with its source, confidence, and assumptions?
HMW close the loop between pre-visit estimate and post-visit bill?

ideas.title: Healthcare Google Flights
ideas.desc: Symptom in, providers on a map with cost ranges. Compare by price, distance, network status.

ideas.title: Provenance-First OOP Estimator
ideas.desc: Every number tagged: FACT / INFERRED / ASSUMED / USER-PROVIDED. Ranges not point estimates. Shows calculation step by step.

ideas.title: Intent-to-Service Mapper
ideas.desc: User types 'my knee hurts after running.' AI returns: 'likely orthopedic consult, CPT 99213-99215, estimated $X-$Y' with transparent mapping.

ideas.title: Insurance Plan Decoder
ideas.desc: 4-question structured flow: deductible, coinsurance, copay, OOP max. Smart defaults. Feeds directly into the estimator.

ideas.title: Browser-Assisted Deductible Retrieval
ideas.desc: Instead of asking users what they've spent, guide them to their insurer portal via Playwright. Extract real deductible remaining.

parked.title: EOB Explainer
parked.desc: Parse EOB documents to compare estimated vs. charged. No machine-readable standard. Post-hackathon.

parked.title: SBC Document Parser
parked.desc: OCR + LLM to extract plan params from PDF SBC. Complex format variance. Use structured user input for MVP.

parked.title: Raw TiC MRF Parsing
parked.desc: 100+ TB, streaming JSON, requires cloud infrastructure. Use Turquoise SSP API and DoltHub as proxies.
